heading: String literals
text:
## String literals [LLEX.13]

```
STRING_LIT  ::= SINGLE_STR | TRIPLE_STR

SINGLE_STR  ::= '"' SINGLE_CHAR* '"'
SINGLE_CHAR ::= <any UTF-8 char except '"', NEWLINE, or '\'>
             |  '\' ESCAPE_SEQ

TRIPLE_STR  ::= '"""' TRIPLE_CHAR* '"""'
TRIPLE_CHAR ::= <any UTF-8 char except unescaped '"""' or '\'>
             |  '\' ESCAPE_SEQ

ESCAPE_SEQ  ::= '"'  | '\'' | '\' | 'n' | 't' | 'r'
             |  'x' HEX_DIGIT HEX_DIGIT
             |  'u' HEX_DIGIT{4}
             |  'U' HEX_DIGIT{8}
```
